query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN street IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as street_is_null,
  SUM(CASE WHEN street = 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as street_is_string_null,
  SUM(CASE WHEN street = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as street_is_empty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN street IS NOT NULL AND street != 'NULL' AND street != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as street_has_value
FROM pco_people WHERE status = 'active' AND latitude IS NOT NULL;
